initialExam.title: West Bengal Police Constable 2026
initialExam.description: Recruitment of Male and Female Constables in West Bengal Police. 11,749 vacancies notified — one of the largest state police recruitments.
initialExam.eligibility: Madhyamik (10th) pass from a recognized board
initialExam.syllabus: General Knowledge & Current Affairs, Elementary Mathematics, Reasoning, English/Bengali.
initialExam.examPattern: Written Test: 100 marks, 1.5 hours. MCQ type. No negative marking.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Test → PMT/PET → Interview → Document Verification → Medical → Final Merit
initialExam.careerGrowth: Constable → Head Constable → ASI → Sub-Inspector → Inspector (through departmental exams).
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit prb.wb.gov.in 2. Register 3. Apply online 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Ration allowance, Uniform allowance, Pension

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: OBC-A/B: 3 years, SC/ST: 5 years, PwD: 10 years
